name: Zoey Henrichs
source: Students know her as being the slow or stupid girl around the academy as if something isn’t right with her mentality. She isn’t very bright and while she is picked on for how she acts, she’s still a very happy girl who tends to feel innocent and childish for her age. She has a very odd fascination with child print underwear along with dressing up in clothing that doesn’t feel fitting for her age. Despite all of this, she still falls victim to students bullying and takes advantage of her.
